jobs.title: Senior Test Automation Engineer (TeamCity)
jobs.description: If you want to build and own the automated testing platform that powers a core piece of developer infrastructure, this is for you. You will focus on writing high-impact code, removing engineering friction, and setting the technical direction for quality on TeamCity. About JetBrains We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale. What you’ll do As our user base grows and enterprise pipelines become more complex, ensuring the highest quality for TeamCity is critical for the people who depend on us daily. We are looking for a senior engineer to own the quality engineering platform behind TeamCity. This is not a manual testing role or a suite maintenance job. You will spend your time writing code, building the tooling and frameworks that enable dozens of product engineers to ship confidently, removing manual work surrounding releases, and making our developer experience measurably better. You will lead the technical direction for quality on a large, feature-rich product, bring practical AI approaches into the workflow where they genuinely add value, and collaborate across teams to help product engineers own their tests. Day to day, you will: Evolve the automated testing platform, including frameworks, infrastructure, reporting, and CI/CD chains. Identify slow, manual, or fragile parts of our engineering process – such as release automation, feedback loops, and test flakiness – and fix them at the root. Integrate AI into the quality workflow for test generation with guardrails, automated failure triage, and self-healing tests. Work directly with product teams to help them write and own their tests, review their contributions, and evangelize solid test design. Investigate failures and flakiness across both tests and product code to drive them to resolution. Participate in all stages of product development, from initial design through release, interacting with internal and external users. What you’ll bring An engineer’s approach to quality, preferring to build tools and automate processes rather than maintain legacy tasks. Strong architectural judgment and a commitment to writing clean, maintainable code. Practical curiosity about AI, with a clear point of view on where it genuinely helps and where it falls short. A habit of working independently without formal specifications, figuring out the product, and determining what matters most. Clear, direct communication skills and the initiative to walk up to developers and persuade teams to improve how they work. An interest in mentoring colleagues, setting technical standards, and sharing knowledge across teams. What you’ll need Advanced skills in Kotlin or Java, with a solid grasp of object-oriented design and design patterns. Hands-on experience building and maintaining test automation for complex, mission-critical backends, web services, or desktop applications. Proficiency with testing frameworks (TestNG or JUnit) and browser automation (Selenium WebDriver, Selenide, or Playwright). Experience with build automation tools such as Gradle or Maven, containerization using Docker or Podman, and reporting tools like Allure. Command of Git and a solid understanding of software testing principles and concurrent programming concepts. A proven track record of creating internal platform tools or developer-experience improvements that measurably speed up engineering workflows. Fluency in spoken and written English. What success looks like Success in this role means transforming our quality infrastructure into a seamless, fast, and reliable platform that engineering teams love to use. You will have eliminated major sources of manual release work, reduced test flakiness, and established automated feedback loops that let developers ship code with total confidence. Product engineers will independently write high-quality tests using your frameworks, and your pragmatic integration of AI tools will have measurably improved failure triage and test creation. Why join JetBrains? Strong base salary. We offer competitive pay that reflects your skills and experience. Flexible work location. Enjoy the freedom to work from home or from the office. Remote work. Spend up to 30 days per year working remotely from abroad. Extra time off. More days to relax, recharge, and do the things you love.</

jobs.title: QA Engineer (Manual)
jobs.description: We are building the first AI-native platform for automated product compliance in MedTech . REMATIQ turn hundreds of page of complex regulations (like MDR and FDA guidance) into structured, actionable requirements that plug directly into our customers’ development and quality processes. The result: life‑saving medical devices reach patients faster and safer. We work with some of the world’s leading life sciences and MedTech companies, including Philips, Siemens Healthineers, B. Braun, and Novartis. We are backed by exceptional investors, having recently closed a Series A round. We believe in the value of in-person collaboration and work in a hybrid setup, with the team coming together in our office in the heart of Berlin-Mitte typically four days per week . What you’ll do As a Manual QA Engineer at REMATIQ, you will own product quality across the edge cases automated tests don’t catch and the bugs that need to be driven through to resolution. You’ll work closely with Engineering to explore unusual documents, broken inputs, interrupted workflows, non-deterministic AI outputs, permission edge cases, and other failure modes that are difficult to anticipate upfront. This is a hands-on quality ownership role. You’ll combine exploratory testing with disciplined bug triage, making sure issues are reproducible, prioritised appropriately, fixed, verified, and genuinely closed. You’ll own two things: Explore edge cases beyond automated testing. Automated tests check what someone thought to check. You’ll explore unusual documents, broken inputs, half-finished workflows, non-deterministic AI outputs, permission corner cases, and other scenarios that may otherwise be missed. Own the bug backlog from report to resolution. Reproduce and document incoming issues, assess severity, prioritise with the Engineering Lead, track fixes, verify them, and keep the backlog accurate and actionable. What you’ll bring Strong manual QA experience on web products, including exploratory testing, test design, and regression planning Experience owning bug triage and backlog quality, not just reporting issues and moving on Exceptionally clear bug reports with reproducible steps, environment details, and expected vs. actual behaviour Enough technical fluency to investigate before escalating: browser dev tools, logs, network requests, APIs, and basic system behaviour Good judgement about risk and the confidence to say “this isn’t ready” when it matters Fluent English, our working language Nice to have: experience in regulated domains such as medical devices, pharma, or finance; ISTQB certification; German. Why this role is interesting Quality is central to the product. Thoroughness is part of the work, not an afterthought. You’ll work with AI-enabled software. That includes testing non-deterministic AI outputs alongside more traditional product behaviour. You’ll work closely with an AI-first engineering team and MedTech domain experts. jobs.title: Flight Test Engineer & Onsite Test Coordinator (all genders)
jobs.description: About Us STARK is a new kind of defence technology company, revolutionizing the way autonomous systems are deployed across multiple domains. We design, develop and manufacture high-performance unmanned systems that are software-defined, mass-scalable, and cost-effective. This provides our operators with a decisive edge in highly contested environments. We’re focused on delivering deployable, high-performance systems. In a time of rising threats, STARK is bolstering the technological edge of NATO Allies and their Partners to deter aggression and defend Europe. About the team You will be working closely with the Flight Test Team and reporting to the Technical Director. Your mission As a Flight Test Engineer & Onsite Test Coordinator , you are the "Conductor of the Flight Line." Depending on your seniority, you will be responsible for the end-to-end lifecycle of our flight test campaigns, from initial planning and hazard assessment to execution and deep-dive data analysis. Beyond the technical data, you serve as the primary Onsite Leader . You are the person who ensures testing priorities are crystal clear to everyone on the range. You manage the daily tempo, coordinate the crew, and ensure that every person, from pilots to software engineers, knows exactly which tests are being conducted and when. Your mission is to transform raw flight data into actionable insights while maintaining a high-tempo, disciplined, and safe testing environment. Responsibilities Onsite Test Coordination & Leadership Act as the Onsite Test Coordinator: Lead daily operations on the range, ensuring the team stays focused on the primary test objectives. Clarify Priorities: Maintain and communicate the "Daily Flight Schedule," ensuring everyone knows the sequence of events and current testing priorities. Lead Briefings: Drive the morning "Pre-Flight Brief" and the evening "Debrief," capturing critical feedback and setting goals for the following day. Resource Management: Coordinate the availability of airframes, ground support equipment, and personnel to maximize range time efficiency. Flight Execution & Safety Coordinate and execute UAV flight tests in compliance with regulatory requirements and STARK safety standards. Ensure all flight activities and anomalies are documented with high fidelity. Develop specific Flight Test Techniques (FTTs) and instrumentation requirements to capture critical performance metrics. Lead Flight Readiness Reviews (FRR) and contribute to safety review boards. Test Design & Data Analysis Develop comprehensive flight test plans, test cards, and rigorous flight test hazard assessments (FTHA). Process and analyze flight data using MATLAB or Python to validate system performance against requirements. Work closely with Ardupilot and PX4-based flight control systems to iterate on flight behavior and performance. Manage the configuration of flight test articles, ensuring all hardware and software versions are meticulously tracked. Qualifications Educational & Legal Background Degree: Bachelor’s or higher in Aerospace, Electrical, Mechanical, or Systems Engineering. NATO Citizenship: Must be a citizen of a NATO member state (due to export control and security regulations). Communication: Professional-level written and verbal English. jobs.description: Join Axon and be a Force for Good. At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter. Your Impact Axon’s RF sensors detect and locate drones so public safety and critical infrastructure teams can protect airspace. You will own the test strategy and independent verification approach for RF sensor capabilities — spanning regression, integration, and real-world validation — so those systems are trustworthy in the lab and in the field. You will work closely with RF Engineering at the intersection of software, hardware, and real-world RF, helping turn technical evidence into confident product decisions. Work Location: This role is based out of our Kassel, Germany office and follows a hybrid schedule. We rely on in-person collaboration and ask that team members work onsite Tuesdays through Fridays, with the flexibility to work remotely on Mondays, unless there is an approved workplace accommodation. We believe that connection fuels innovation, and our in-office culture is designed to foster meaningful teamwork, mentorship, and shared success. What You’ll Do Own the test strategy and independent verification approach for RF sensor software from design through release, adding rigor through regression, integration, and real-world validation. Design and own test strategies spanning feature, regression, integration / interface, system, and field validation. Combine automated coverage with targeted manual validation based on risk and technical feasibility. Develop in-depth functional tests for individual components of the RF sensor software, and keep those tests maintainable as the product evolves. Reproduce, isolate, and characterize issues on real sensor hardware and in test environments; capture clear reproduction steps, logs, and environment details. Build and maintain hardware-backed automated regression tests and supporting test tooling. Monitor and improve development and test systems and test hardware so environments stay stable, observable, and ready for daily use. Partner closely with RF Engineering and independently verify behavior in realistic environments and across system interfaces. Execute system, release, field, and acceptance testing with release stakeholders. Document test results and defects clearly, and contribute to software design reviews and after-action reviews for the work you own. Share knowledge with the wider team, give actionable feedback, and support newer engineers and interns through pairing, reviews, and onboarding. Use approved agentic AI tools regularly to design tests, analyze results, and draft documentation and review AI output against quality, security, and performance standards before you rely on it. What You Bring A degree or vocational qualification in electrical engineering, computer science, embedded systems, or a related field 3+ years of experience testing software that runs on or with hardware (embedded products, devices, sensors, or similar systems), including independently owning the test and quality approach for that work. Experience with RF, embedded, sensor, or similarly hardware-integrated systems, with the technical aptitude and curiosity to develop deep expertise in RF sensor technologies. Hands-on experience building and maintaining automated tests or test tooling, ideally in Python pytest, with the ability to independently support hardware-backed regression testing. Comfort working in Linux-based systems (SSH, Networking). A collaborative, quality-focused working style: you Join Forces with others, Own It on the quality of the work you take on, and speak up with candor when something is unclear or broken. It’s a plus if you have experience with drones or hardware-in-the-loop / continuous integration test setups and an interest in supporting others as they grow. Don’t meet every single requirement?
